accounts.elixpo.name: Elixpo Accounts
accounts.elixpo.summary: Shared identity and account management for Elixpo services.
accounts.elixpo.description: Elixpo Accounts provides the common sign-in and account layer used across supported Elixpo services, with standards-oriented OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect integration for applications.

admin.elixpo.name: Elixpo Admin
admin.elixpo.summary: Operational administration for the Elixpo service network.
admin.elixpo.description: The internal administration surface used to operate and inspect supported Elixpo services. It is listed for transparency, while privileged functions remain restricted.

agent.elixpo.name: Elixpoo
agent.elixpo.summary: Elixpo's active organization-wide GitHub project-management and review agent.
agent.elixpo.description: Elixpoo v2 consistently classifies repository work, maintains approved labels and Project fields, answers exact mentions, provides evidence-grounded pull-request reviews, supports the canonical Discussions surface, and records bounded merged-change context. Its deterministic permission boundary prevents it from editing product source or acting as an autonomous coding agent.

art.elixpo.name: Elixpo Art
art.elixpo.summary: An archived creative-generation experiment from Elixpo's earlier era.
art.elixpo.description: Elixpo Art is preserved as part of the organization history. It is no longer presented as an active service or maintained project.

blogs.elixpo.name: LixBlogs
blogs.elixpo.summary: Open publishing for technical stories, rich documents, and creator workflows.
blogs.elixpo.description: LixBlogs is Elixpo's operated publishing service. Its editor and publishing workflow support technical writing with structured blocks, diagrams, equations, code, media, and automation through a public CLI.

chat.elixpo.name: Elixpo Chat
chat.elixpo.summary: An archived conversational application preserved as an Elixpo project record.
chat.elixpo.description: Elixpo Chat is retained as a historical project record and is no longer maintained or operated as a current Elixpo service.

claudeOps.elixpo.name: ClaudeOps
claudeOps.elixpo.summary: An archived connected optimization toolkit not maintained by Elixpo.
claudeOps.elixpo.description: ClaudeOps remains visible for historical accuracy. Elixpo does not maintain the project as an active package and does not include it in current release work.

clock.elixpo.name: Elixpo Clock
clock.elixpo.description: Elixpo Clock explored animated time and timezone interfaces. The repository is archived and retained as part of the public record.

crumb.elixpo.name: Crumb
crumb.elixpo.summary: A self-hosted autonomous agent harness and natural language terminal powered by Pollinations.
crumb.elixpo.description: Crumb is Elixpo's active pre-release Rust agent harness and native-first terminal. It keeps Bash, Zsh, and PowerShell behavior intact while its locally operated harness manages autonomous planning, approved tools, sessions, memory, checkpoints, background work, and agent supervision. Pollinations provides the default model intelligence without owning Crumb's execution or permission boundary.

cypher.name: Cypher
cypher.summary: An incubating core Elixpo application preparing for active product development.
cypher.description: Cypher preserves the original Safe Cypher prototype while Elixpo prepares its next development phase. The current code explores authentication, encrypted data storage, and role-based account workflows without presenting the prototype as production-ready security software.

elixpo_chapter.name: Elixpo Chapter
elixpo_chapter.summary: The master collection where public build chapters become durable releases.
elixpo_chapter.description: Elixpo Chapter is the central repository for the foundry model: time-bounded public work, prepared contribution paths, review, release records, and the shared history of what people built together.

emoji_transnetv1.name: Emoji TransNet
emoji_transnetv1.summary: An archived translation experiment with a released Hugging Face model.
emoji_transnetv1.description: Emoji TransNet is an earlier Elixpo mT5 experiment for translating emoji-rich text into plain-English descriptions. The source is archived, while its public MIT-licensed model remains available as a released research artifact.

falcon.name: Falcon
falcon.summary: A completed automation experiment built at deliberately unusual scale.
falcon.description: Falcon is a completed research-side experiment in automated repository activity. It is preserved as an intentionally playful study, including its unusually large commit history, rather than presented as an active product.

jackey.elixpo.name: Jackey
jackey.elixpo.summary: An archived generation bot and community experiment.
jackey.elixpo.description: Jackey is the canonical final repository for an earlier Elixpo bot project. It is archived and remains available as a historical implementation record.

Kareixo.name: Kareixo
Kareixo.summary: An independently led Member Project building within the Elixpo commons.
Kareixo.description: Kareixo is an active Elixpo Member Project transferred by its maintainer while retaining visible author agency. It demonstrates the long-term member-project path beyond a time-bounded Chapter.

lixrl.com.name: Lixrl
lixrl.com.summary: Short links, managed redirects, analytics, and production-ready QR codes.
lixrl.com.description: Lixrl is an actively operated Elixpo service for shortening and managing links, observing their use, and generating QR codes. Its companion CLI supports repeatable developer and automation workflows.

mails.elixpo.name: Elixpo Mails
mails.elixpo.summary: Shared email infrastructure for supported Elixpo services.
mails.elixpo.description: Elixpo Mails provides the common email workspace and delivery surfaces used by the ecosystem's operated services, reducing duplicated infrastructure across projects.

me.elixpo.name: Elixpo Members
me.elixpo.summary: Standalone portfolios for people whose work forms part of Elixpo.
me.elixpo.description: Elixpo Members gives contributors a durable professional home for their projects, experience, publications, and public identity. The portal links to these profiles wherever an enrolled member is credited.

monodiffuse.name: MonoDiffuse
monodiffuse.summary: An active diffusion research project with runnable ONNX and binary-network artifacts.
monodiffuse.description: MonoDiffuse studies conditional MNIST diffusion with conventional and W1A32 binary-neural-network variants. Its public record connects the source repository, MIT-licensed ONNX model artifacts, and the Diffuino interactive Hugging Face demonstration.

octabit.name: OctaBit
octabit.summary: A programmable RISC-style 8-bit computer built and documented on breadboards.
octabit.description: OctaBit is an open computer-architecture project built from discrete logic, breadboards, EEPROM microcode, and Arduino control tooling. Its record connects the MIT-licensed source, schematics and hardware documentation to the published June 2025 paper.

search.elixpo.name: OreoLook
search.elixpo.summary: Open AI search and deep research with cited answers, reproducibility artifacts, and a public architecture paper.
search.elixpo.description: OreoLook, formerly lixSearch, is an open answer engine for live web research and cited reports. Its connected public record includes the operated search site, the Elixpo/OreoLook Hugging Face Space, the CC BY 4.0 evaluation dataset, the externally stewarded source repository, and arXiv preprint 2609.05463 on three-layer caching for low-latency LLM web search.

Nano28C64.name: Nano28C64
Nano28C64.summary: A maintained side project publishing circuits and hardware releases.
Nano28C64.description: Nano28C64 is a hardware-oriented side project maintained for its released circuit artifacts and targeted improvements, with its implementation record kept in the open.

opensource.elixpo.name: Elixpo Open Source
opensource.elixpo.summary: An incubating service for navigating open contribution work.
opensource.elixpo.description: Elixpo Open Source is under development. It is intended to make contribution opportunities and public project work easier to discover without overstating unfinished capabilities.

oreo.name: Oreo
oreo.summary: An open hardware badge, operated site, and research platform running OreoOS.
oreo.description: Oreo combines an actively maintained website, open hardware, embedded software, applications, games, and research. The badge is designed as a platform people can study, extend, and use for shared event experiences.

oreoPI.name: OreoPI
oreoPI.summary: A paused hardware and agent-infrastructure companion project.
oreoPI.description: OreoPI is part of the planned common agent and device infrastructure around Elixpo. It remains visible while paused so its status is unambiguous.

packages.elixpo.name: Elixpo Packages
packages.elixpo.summary: The central distribution repository for Linux packages released by Elixpo.
packages.elixpo.description: Elixpo Packages collects Linux package definitions and releases in a single sub-monorepo and provides a dedicated distribution surface connected back to the projects that produce them.

payouts.elixpo.name: Elixpo Payouts
payouts.elixpo.summary: Shared operational tooling for tracked payout workflows.
payouts.elixpo.description: Elixpo Payouts is an actively maintained core service for the ecosystem's supported payout operations. Its listing describes the system without exposing restricted administrative functions.

qfabric.name: QFabric
qfabric.summary: A completed open research project with a preserved implementation record.
qfabric.description: QFabric has reached a completed research state. Its dossier keeps the work, repository, and status discoverable without suggesting an active product roadmap.

rewrite.elixpo.name: Rewrite
rewrite.elixpo.summary: An archived Elixpo writing experiment preserved without a maintenance promise.
rewrite.elixpo.description: Rewrite is no longer maintained. Its repository remains available as a historical project record and is clearly separated from current services.

sketch.elixpo.name: LixSketch
sketch.elixpo.summary: A hand-drawn SVG canvas for visual thinking and programmable diagrams.
sketch.elixpo.description: LixSketch is an open WYSIWYG whiteboard and reusable canvas engine for free-form drawing, structured diagrams, portable scenes, exports, and programmatic visual workflows.

status.elixpo.name: Elixpo Status
status.elixpo.summary: Public operational status for Elixpo's hosted services.
status.elixpo.description: Elixpo Status makes service availability and incidents visible from a dedicated operational surface, keeping reliability information separate from product marketing.

tommy.elixpo.name: Tommy
tommy.elixpo.summary: An archived Elixpo community project preserved as part of the public history.
tommy.elixpo.description: Tommy is no longer maintained. The repository remains public as part of the organization's historical record.

videolize.name: Videolize
videolize.summary: An archived video-oriented project retained as a historical implementation record.
videolize.description: Videolize is no longer maintained and is retained as a historical project rather than an active Elixpo offering.

wish.elixpo.name: Wish
wish.elixpo.summary: An archived project pending any future redevelopment decision.
wish.elixpo.description: Wish is archived while its future development remains undecided. No current release or maintenance promise is implied.

wozformer.name: WozFormer
wozformer.summary: Active research into language-model inference on constrained 6502 hardware.
wozformer.description: WozFormer develops and evaluates very small language-model architectures for a 1 MHz 6502 with tightly limited SRAM and EEPROM. Its public notebooks, model exports, findings, hardware work, and paper draft form an inspectable research record while the study continues.
